nom: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum for Beginners

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports less textured, more plumped skin and fewer bumps within a week, with no purging.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the retinol did not cause irritation, redness, or stinging, unlike other retinols they had tried.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive/combination skin says this retinol did not sting or redden her skin the way a 0.1% retinol did, and her skin felt softer within days.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 30s new to anti-aging products reports reduced wrinkles and smaller-looking pores, plus a reviewer noting improving fine lines and diminished acne scars.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report reduced fine lines, wrinkles, and smaller-looking pores, with one describing visible improvement and outside compliments after a few weeks; effects are described as gradual over weeks.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe skin as more hydrated, plumped, and smooth the morning after use, with one saying she dropped her night cream entirely.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers who reacted badly to other retinols (redness, stinging) report no such reaction with this serum.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the serum as gentle with panthenol to calm the skin from the actives, and report little to no purging or stinging even as retinol beginners.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports acne scars diminishing over about a month.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports a few bumps gone overnight and no purging; this is a single report, not corroborated elsewhere.
concerns.oiliness: Only one reviewer mentions oily skin, focused on texture and blemishes rather than oil control specifically, so no clear pattern on oiliness itself.

aspects.libelle: Dropper delivers little to no product

extraits.texte: I have oily acne prone skin I've been using this retinol for almost a week now and I wish I got it sooner. Ive noticed my skin is feeling less textured and more plumped. I even had a few bumps that were gone when I woke up. Im experience with retinols but this formula is gentle and I havent had any of the typical purging sensations. You only need a pea size amount as a little bit goes a long way I have even used this on my hands at night and the back of my hands are feeling smoother too. If your looking for a retinol or have been scared by them in the past like myself give this one a try.

I have been using this for about a month and my skin loves it. Every other retinol I've tried turned me terribly red and irritated my skin. This stuff doesn't irritate my skin at all! I had very little purging. My acne scars are diminished and my fine lines are improving already. New holy grail!!!

extraits.titre: Must have for anti-aging and glowy skin!
extraits.texte: I love this serum so much that I am already on my second bottle! Just a little goes a long way, apply it to your cleaned, toned face at night and you will wake up with a nice plump look. I have sensitive skin and this worked well on my face without causing any issues. I even noticed i ditched my night face cream because this (even when used alone) does the job!

extraits.titre: Seriously so glad I tried this product
extraits.texte: I ordered the trial kit that came with this and the matching eye cream. I came back to buy this again and I was very surprised to see the lower rating, and honestly, the two low ratings I dont believe are quite fair. Ive been using both every night for a few weeks now. I have seen very noticeable differences! It has definitely reduced my wrinkles and pore-sizes. For reference, I'm a W female in my 30s, but just recently started using anti-aging products. I have noticable wrinkles, but this product has definitely helped! I am usually pretty critical and I will not buy a product again at similar price points if it doesnt work. After a few weeks, not only did I notice the results, but I have gotten so many compliments about how I look younger, which has completely stunned me! Ive tried several other anti-aging products, and this is the first one that ive actually received compliments about. I highly recommend this product! Don't let the few negative reviews deter you. I don't know about you, but if a product works, im willing to pay extra for it. Its not unheard of for a product to be expensive, but I'm honestly shocked it's not higher priced, yet works better than some of the prestige brands.

I have sensitive/combination skin and it's a challenge to find a retinol that works for my skin. Surprisingly, this Some By Mi Retinol worked just fine. Its light, not sticky, and doesn't sting vs. other brands at 0.1% Retinol I had to give up on day 1 because of the stinging pain and redness it caused. It's been a few days and so far my skin feels softer. Looking forward to the long term results with this one. And I like how the container is lightweight. It's travel friendly size so I don't have to worry about repacking or checking in bags. For a frequent traveler, this is a big plus for me.

I was so excited to try this serum and finally got my hands on it about 2 weeks ago. I did notice that the dropper was being a bit difficult and that it wasn't grabbing a lot of product. Nonetheless, I got the few drops I could (which wasn't alot)when I'd use it. Somehow I'm already close to finishing this product. Mind you, I use it every other day. My sister happened to get this product earlier today. She called me saying that the dropper is flimsy and not picking up product and that the bottle looks almost empty. Soooo not sure what's going on, but I hope they fix that because it's a great serum!! My skin has been looking very smooth and I think its partly from this every other night. Hope it gets resolved.
Could hardly get any product out of dropper. Completely empty by day 5. So disappointing wanted to love this.
